verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own pages list a Collective Mode for scheduling links and say a link can show combined availability for you and any number of teammates, so recipients book a time with the whole selected group. Round robin links can also add a person who is invited to every meeting, which works like a required host. The rule that slots appear only when every host is free is implied by this wording rather than stated outright. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that collective links show only slots where all required hosts are free, detailed collective-mode configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free

citations.quote: Show combined availability for you and any number of teammates that allow recipients to book a time with your selected group.
Combine your availability with multiple colleagues on scheduling links.
